source.name: Axal VC verified global fund managers (2026-11-19)
source.title: Axal VC worldwide fund-manager evidence, 19 November 2026

methodology: One candidate per investment manager or independently branded investment platform. A specific fund vehicle is recorded as a relationship or activity event rather than counted again.
Primary evidence consists of manager sites, issuer-authored announcements, official registries, and institutional-investor or government disclosures. Every candidate includes direct evidence URLs.

Candidates were compared with served baseline names, declared fund-number manager keys, UIDs, official and legacy domains, former brands, and named vehicles. Regional research batches received an independent cross-review.
Existing records excluded by source-visibility rules do not become evidence for a candidate. Such candidates were researched independently from retained primary sources.
Research groups organize this workbook and are neither headquarters claims nor exclusive investment mandates. Investment geography is recorded separately.

Headquarters are populated only when explicitly designated in retained evidence. Source publication dates are retained where known. Office addresses, legal domiciles, parent locations and investment markets are not substituted for headquarters.

A manager-level profile, portfolio, or fund-close announcement does not establish that a fund is currently fundraising or accepting new investments. No fund-size, vintage, ticket-size or performance fields are inferred.
Null geography or headquarters means not established by the reviewed sources, not that the firm lacks a geographic focus or headquarters.

The second research batch was reconciled against both merged directory records and the pending #7325 import. Manager/platform overlaps are excluded from this increment, including named vehicle links and former names.
Each record keeps the actual date its primary evidence was checked; the compilation date is not substituted for older per-record dates.
Research summaries in this evidence file describe manager/platform mandates; the database import leaves vehicle financial, vintage, stage, sector and investment-country facts unrecorded.
Singapore nVentures is matched only by qualified identity and its official domain; its bare brand is ambiguous with NVIDIA NVentures.
A second independent review checked the 17 new candidates against the served migration baseline, previous 73 candidates and pending 605-row manifest.

funds.name: BAI Capital
funds.notes: Formerly Bertelsmann Asia Investments. The team conducted independent fundraising at the end of 2020, attracting external institutional investors. This source does not establish a date of ownership independence.
funds.focus_summary: Early- to growth-stage investment across retail, consumer and services, media and content innovation, industrial technology and software, and frontier technologies.
funds.geography_summary: China-focused venture investor supporting portfolio companies in China and international markets.

funds.name: Beta.Ventures
funds.notes: Official homepage explicitly identifies a venture-capital firm and investment portfolio. New York and Lagos are described as bases, not formally designated headquarters. Beta.Vestors is a named subsidiary and is not separately added. Distinct from served Beta Boom, Betaworks Ventures, Bloomberg Beta and betacluster Ventures. No formal round range is invented from the product-development language. No served, prior73 or pending605 match found.
funds.focus_summary: Technology-led ventures, with support from product idea through launch and subsequent company development; emphasis on revenue and profit growth. Exact financing-round limits are not specified.
funds.geography_summary: African companies with international scaling potential; the official portfolio includes businesses operating across multiple African markets.

funds.name: Bicycle Capital
funds.notes: Official manager homepage verifies identity. Primary institutional investor IDB Invest identifies Bicycle Management Company, L.P. as manager of Bicycle I, L.P., and explicitly states dual headquarters in Miami and São Paulo. This is growth equity/private equity for technology companies, so it should not be classified as a seed-only venture manager. No served baseline match found. The headquarters and first-fund stage evidence is from the IDB Invest announcement dated September 30, 2025.
funds.focus_summary: Early-growth and growth-stage technology companies; the first fund is described as investing from Series B to IPO.
funds.geography_summary: Latin America and the Caribbean.

activity_evidence.description: IDB Invest announced its equity commitment to Bicycle I, L.P.

funds.name: Brandon Capital
funds.notes: Brandon manages Brandon BioCatalyst, formerly Medical Research Commercialisation Fund/MRCF. These are linked managed vehicles/collaborations, not separate manager additions. Office presence in Australia, New Zealand, UK and US is not treated as HQ.
funds.focus_summary: Life-sciences venture capital, including early biomedical discovery commercialization, seed and venture financing.
funds.geography_summary: Australasian life-science focus; Brandon BioCatalyst specifically supports research commercialization in Australia and New Zealand.

funds.name: BuenTrip Ventures
funds.notes: Official strategy explicitly describes first-check investment in pre-seed and seed B2B software businesses. Included for direct venture investment, not solely its accelerator or ecosystem-building programme. Ecuador association and event context are not used as an HQ designation. No served, prior73 or pending605 match found, including BuenTrip spelling variants.
funds.focus_summary: Pre-seed and seed B2B software companies, often as a first investor, with founder and operating support.
funds.geography_summary: Latin America and Latin American founders abroad.

funds.name: Canary

funds.focus_summary: Early-stage venture capital, including inception and first institutional backing.
funds.geography_summary: Latin America.

funds.name: Dolma Fund Management
funds.notes: The official site identifies Dolma Fund Management as the Mauritius FSC-regulated CIS manager of Dolma Impact Fund I and II. Record the manager once and keep those vehicles as relationships. Do not equate the separate Dolma charitable foundation with the investment manager or infer headquarters from the Mauritius contact address.
funds.focus_summary: Impact and growth capital for revenue-generating companies, with significant minority ownership. Core sectors are technology, healthcare, and renewable energy; additional sectors include agribusiness, education, logistics, and manufacturing.
funds.geography_summary: Companies in Nepal or with a significant operational presence in Nepal.

Direct text extraction of the JavaScript site returned no readable lines; the indexed official URL with a source parameter supplied the mandate text. The clean domain is the proposed public website. Venezuelan portfolio and team connections are not substituted for headquarters. No served, prior73 or pending605 match found.
funds.focus_summary: Pre-seed and seed investment, with fintech and AI emphasized while retaining a broader founder-led selection approach.
funds.geography_summary: United States and Latin America, explicitly labeled in the official homepage's founder section.

funds.focus_summary: Sector-agnostic pre-seed and seed venture investments with hands-on support for technology startups.
funds.geography_summary: Pakistan, including companies with a direct connection to Pakistan.

activity_evidence.description: IFC's disclosure records its investment in i2i Venture Capital Fund I LP as invested on this date; this is an LP commitment event, not evidence of current fundraising.

related_vehicles: i2i Venture Capital Fund I LP

No served, prior73 or pending605 match found.
funds.focus_summary: Pre-seed and seed impact investing, including lead investments and follow-ons, in businesses with measurable, scalable social or environmental benefits.
funds.geography_summary: Latin America excluding Brazil, as stated in the Fund I thesis.

funds.focus_summary: Early-stage venture investing across sectors, often providing a startup's first funding.
funds.geography_summary: Pakistani founders and the Pakistan startup ecosystem.

Its official history distinguishes the manager from Insitor Seed Pilot and Insitor Impact Asia Funds I and II. Office openings and incorporation country are not used as headquarters evidence.
funds.focus_summary: Early-stage impact venture investments in startups, with participation in subsequent rounds, flexible investment structures, and hands-on support.
funds.geography_summary: Insitor Impact Asia Fund II targets Cambodia, India, and Pakistan. The earlier Insitor Impact Asia Fund also included Myanmar.

Kamay Code's official terms identify Coca-Cola Latin America, Grupo Arcor and Grupo Bimbo as LPs; these corporate sponsors are not treated as equivalent manager aliases. IDB's project record independently corroborates venture investment activity. Ecosystem city list is not an HQ designation. No served, prior73 or pending605 match found; Overboost was also checked as a historical relationship lead.
funds.focus_summary: Seed and pre-Series A ventures serving the consumer-goods value chain, including AI, financial infrastructure, data, operating efficiency, supply chains and energy.
funds.geography_summary: Latin America.

funds.name: Kayyak Ventures

The Chilean venture association's member profile corroborates the manager and KAYYAK II LP vehicle. Chilean association membership is not converted into an HQ claim. No served, prior73 or pending605 match found under manager or fund names.
funds.focus_summary: Seed, Series A and Series B investments in mission-driven companies, generally with revenues and attractive unit economics; social and environmental challenges feature in the stated philosophy.
funds.geography_summary: Primarily Latin America; also businesses led by Latin American founders in the United States and Europe.

funds.name: Latitud

Thus this is not included solely as an educational network. Formal country eligibility is not asserted from the founder-community description. Distinct from the served UK manager Latitude at latitudeventures.vc. No served baseline match found.
funds.focus_summary: Very early technology investing, including pre-company ideation and pre-seed checks, with founder support.
funds.geography_summary: Latin American founder ecosystem with global investor connections; reviewed pages do not define an exclusive country-by-country investment eligibility list.

funds.name: MCS Ventures
funds.notes: MCS Ventures LLC is the investment arm of MCS Group. MStars is a program within this platform, not an additional manager. The Ulaanbaatar contact address is not explicitly designated headquarters.
funds.focus_summary: Corporate venture investments in technology startups and digital-lifestyle businesses, with operational and growth support.
funds.geography_summary: Mongolia's startup ecosystem. Global growth ambitions are described, but no broader investment-country mandate is inferred.

funds.name: Mekong Strategic Capital
funds.notes: Mekong Strategic Ventures is part of Mekong Strategic Capital and the general partner/manager of Smart Axiata Digital Innovation Fund (SADIF). Smart Axiata is an LP, not a manager alias. Angkor Growth Investments is another platform fund. The official About page still uses Mekong Strategic Partners in its careers text, so that name is retained as a legacy deduplication key; no rebrand date is asserted.
funds.focus_summary: Investment management across financial services, technology, renewable energy, infrastructure, and real estate. Its venture platform manages SADIF, which has invested in early-stage and growth-stage digital companies.
funds.geography_summary: Greater Mekong region; SADIF specifically invests in Cambodian digital companies.

activity_evidence.description: Official announcement of the sale of SADIF's equity stake in Nham24 to Grab, with Mekong Strategic Ventures named as general partner.

funds.name: N47

funds.focus_summary: Product-led venture investing; official portfolio labels initial partnerships at Series A, B and C across applications, infrastructure and systems.

activity_evidence.description: Dated homepage portfolio item: leading Longeye Series A.

funds.name: Novo Holdings
funds.notes: Annual report establishes former Novo A/S name and that Novo Ventures became the Venture Investments business. Novo Holdings owns the investment mandate; Novo Ventures (US) and other subsidiaries provide consultancy services per website footer. Broader non-VC activities are disclosed; no HQ inferred from offices. Current canonical domain is novoholdings.com; novoholdings.dk is retained only for legacy identity matching.
funds.focus_summary: Diversified investment company with direct life-science Seed Investments and Venture Investments, alongside growth, principal, public-market and other strategies.
funds.geography_summary: The investment overview identifies North America, Europe and Asia; Seed Investments specifically focuses on building life-science companies in the Nordic region.

funds.name: nVentures (Singapore)
funds.notes: The MAS directory identifies NVENTURES PTE. LTD. as a Singapore-incorporated venture capital fund manager, with Ashok Kumar Verma as Founding Partner/CEO; the official team page identifies Ashok Verma. This is the nventures.sg manager, distinct from NVIDIA's NVentures. Singapore incorporation and office information are not treated as an explicit headquarters designation. Bare nventures and unqualified numbered-fund keys are intentionally excluded from cross-manager matching because they do not distinguish this manager from NVIDIA; related vehicles remain scoped to the official Singapore domain.
funds.focus_summary: Pre-seed and seed venture investing in B2B enterprise technology, including fintech and regtech; the first fund focused on B2B fintech.
funds.geography_summary: South Asia and Southeast Asia, including Sri Lankan founders building businesses with regional or global potential.

funds.name: OBOR Management
funds.notes: The official group site distinguishes OBOR Management, its regulated fund manager, from OBOR Capital, the original investment vehicle, and OBOR Advisory, a separate consulting business. OBOR Capital and AXS Ventures are related vehicles, not additional manager entries. oborcapital.com redirects to the current obor.asia platform. Portfolio-company headquarters on the investment page are not the manager's headquarters.
funds.focus_summary: Impact investment management spanning early-stage equity and sustainable infrastructure. Its current stated approach focuses on renewable energy, climate-smart agriculture, forest preservation, infrastructure, and water, including impact-linked loans convertible to equity.
funds.geography_summary: Cambodia, Laos, Vietnam, and Indonesia in the current investment approach.

funds.name: One to Watch
funds.notes: One platform record for One to Watch, abbreviated OTW on its official site, with its SME and renewable-energy vehicles recorded as relationships. The official investment criteria emphasize proven businesses and stable financial performance; no pre-seed or seed mandate is inferred. Netherlands and Nepal contact addresses do not establish headquarters.
funds.focus_summary: Impact investment management providing growth capital to SMEs with proven business models. Its sector-agnostic SME Fund addresses market gaps and basic needs; its Off-grid Renewable Energy Fund supports energy-service businesses.
funds.geography_summary: The SME Fund describes investments in Nepal. The Off-grid Renewable Energy Fund expressly targets Nepal and Bangladesh.
related_vehicles: One to Watch Off-grid Renewable Energy Fund (ORE)

funds.name: ONEVC
funds.notes: Official homepage explicitly identifies seed-stage venture investing across Latin America. Distinguished from Version One Ventures, Type One Ventures, StageOne, SquareOne and System.One. No explicit headquarters designation was recorded. No served baseline match found.
funds.focus_summary: Seed-stage venture capital.
funds.geography_summary: Latin America.

Dhahran, China and US office listings do not establish headquarters.
funds.focus_summary: Diversified technology venture capital; stated areas include enterprise, financial and industrial technologies, blockchain, medtech and healthcare.
funds.geography_summary: Global investment remit.

funds.name: Rally Cap
funds.notes: Current homepage uses Rally Cap; linked RC Global 1 page also uses RaliCap, establishing the identity connection on the official site. It operates named investment funds as well as a collective. Current global fintech mandate is distinguished from the earlier emerging-market B2B infrastructure strategy. Founder biography's former Lateral Capital role does not make the managers identical. San Francisco footer is not labeled headquarters. No served, prior73 or pending605 match found; historical Rally Cap Ventures wording was also checked.
funds.focus_summary: First-check fintech investing at inception; current thesis highlights financial applications built with stablecoins, real-time payments and AI. Earlier RC Global 1 focused on B2B fintech infrastructure.
funds.geography_summary: Global. The earlier emerging-market strategy explicitly referenced Mexico City, Lagos, Cairo and Karachi; the current homepage is broader and is not limited to those markets.

funds.name: ShEquity Partners
funds.notes: Official May 2026 announcement explicitly identifies ShEquity Partners and its ShEquity Climate Fund L.P., distinguishing direct investment from the separate technical-assistance facility. Current strategy is early growth and climate-focused; the 2022 report's seed-to-Series-A description is historical, not imposed as the current mandate. Mauritius contact address is not an explicit HQ designation. Initial direct extraction timed out; the May 2026 official announcement was subsequently retrieved directly and independently verified. No served, prior73 or pending605 match found.
funds.focus_summary: Early-growth investment in gender-smart green SMEs with scalable climate solutions, covering areas such as circular economy, clean transport, renewable energy, sustainable agriculture, water and climate technology.
funds.geography_summary: Africa; current official materials emphasize underserved markets and include Ghana technical-assistance activity. That programme location is not treated as an exclusive investment mandate.

funds.focus_summary: Venture capital, content investments and growth-capital/private-equity strategies.
funds.geography_summary: Korean innovation with support for global-market growth; no exclusive geographic mandate recorded.

funds.name: SP Ventures

Search-indexed older official homepage explicitly described early-stage investing across Latin America, but exact round boundaries are not recorded as current. funds.focus_summary: Venture capital in agriculture, food technology and climate solutions; early-stage description is evidenced in an older indexed official homepage.
funds.geography_summary: Latin America.

funds.focus_summary: Early-stage deep-tech and life-sciences research commercialization investor, with Commercialisation and Venture funds.
funds.geography_summary: Research spinouts from Uniseed's Australian university and research partners; connects portfolio companies to global markets.
